# Curtis Accounting Solutions

> > Specialized accounting and financial advisory firm helping product-based and e-commerce businesses achieve profitability through Profit First methodology and strategic cash flow management.

Curtis Accounting Solutions, founded by Jacob Curtis (CPA and Certified Profit First Professional), serves product-based businesses including e-commerce and retail operations. The firm combines traditional accounting services with the Profit First system popularized by Mike Michalowicz to help business owners achieve financial freedom and sustainable growth.
